enchantments.tooltip: Ethereal: Equipping this item causes your hands and weapons to become partially incorporeal. Your melee attacks do not roll a miss chance for Incorporeal targets.
Dexterity +6: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Accuracy +9: Passive: +9 Competence bonus to attack rolls
Deception +4: +4 Enhancement bonus to hit and +6 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Vulkoor's Chosen: 2 Pieces Equipped:+10 Artifact bonus to Poison Resistance+1 Artifact bonus to Sneak Attack Dice+1 Artifact bonus to Saving Throws+1 Artifact bonus to Dexterity and Constitution
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
